items.description: Within the ecosystem of Arch-based projects, we can find some that use the Linux kernel, and others that do not, expanding even more the options available to Arch lovers.
items.title: Arch-based projects

items.description: Simplicity is one of the great features of Arch Linux, which has led the community to use it for their own distributions. In this section we cover all of these through two categories: those general purpose distros (the ones we usually install on our home computers), and those others that were designed with a particular purpose in mind, be it focused on security, data rescue, servers among others.
items.title: Arch-based distros
aui
items.description: The Archlinux Ultimate Install comprises of two primary scripts, Lilo and Fifo, which streamline the installation process of Archlinux Base, as well as additional packages, tools, and graphical user interfaces.

items.title: Archfi
items.description: Just a simple bash script wizard to install Arch Linux after you have booted on the official Arch Linux install media.

From Arch Wiki:
This section tries to cover all these helpers, divided according to their functionality.
items.title: AUR Helpers
Auracle
items.description: (C++) - A flexible command line client for Arch Linux's User Repository.

items.title: repoctl
items.description: (Go) - Make it easy to manage your local Arch Linux repository.

items.title: Aurutils
items.description: (Bash) - Helper tools for the AUR.

items.title: RUA
items.description: (Rust) - Build tool for Arch Linux providing control, review and jailed build options.

items.title: PKGBUILDer
items.description: (Python) - An AUR helper (and library) in Python 3.

items.title: Yay
items.description: (Go) - Yet another Yogurt, an AUR Helper written in Go.

items.title: Paru
items.description: (Rust) - AUR helper with all needed modern wrapper features, created by a former developer of yay.

items.title: Aura
items.description: (Haskell) - A secure, multilingual package manager for Arch Linux and the AUR.

items.title: pikaur
items.description: (Python) - AUR helper with minimal dependencies. Review PKGBUILDs all in once, next build them all without user interaction.

items.title: Trizen
items.description: (Perl) - Lightweight AUR Package Manager.

items.title: Pakku
items.description: (Nim) - wrapper with AUR support.

items.title: Pacaur
items.description: (Bash) - An AUR helper that minimizes user interaction.

items.title: amethyst
items.description: (Rust) - A fast, efficient and lightweight AUR helper and Pacman wrapper made for Crystal, compatible with any Arch-based Linux distribution.

items.title: Cylon
items.description: (Bash | TUI) - A CLI TUI menu driven bash shell script supporting updates, maintenance, backups and system checks for an Arch based Linux distro.

items.title: Yup
items.description: (Go | TUI) - Arch Linux AUR Helper with ncurses functionality and better searching and sorting.

items.title: Argon
items.description: (Python | GTK3) - lightweight GUI package manager for Arch Linux.

items.title: aurpublish
items.description: PKGBUILD management framework for the Arch User Repository.

items.title: aur-out-of-date
items.description: Determines out-of-date AUR packages w.r.t. upstream version.

items.title: pkgoutofdate
items.description: Checks whether Arch packages are out-of-date.

items.title: package-query
items.description: Tool for querying and the AUR.

items.title: aur-talk
items.description: A script to fetch and display AUR package comments.

items.title: aurvote-utils
items.description: A set of utilities for managing AUR votes.

items.title: JuNest
items.description: A lightweight Arch Linux-based distro that runs, without root privileges, upon any Linux distro.

items.title: Dotfiles Generator
items.description: Dotfiles generator that allows quick configuration of different Window Managers and tools in multiple operating systems, including any Arch Linux-based distribution.

items.title: tarman
items.description: The portable, cross-platform, extensible, and simple package manager for tarballs (and others!).

items.title: makepkg-optimize
items.description: A collection of supplemental tidy, buildenv, and executable scripts for pacman which provide macros for several kinds of optimization in the build() and package() stages.
